text:
ITEM 1 | Long thin green beans, bright to olive green with slightly darker tips, glossy and moist-looking, whole pods about 8-12 cm long, some with small cut ends, arranged in a loose pile on the left third of the plate, with a few scattered bits of light brown seasoning or garlic beside them | 110
ITEM 2 | Whole cherry tomatoes, glossy red-orange with smooth skins and a few lighter patches, halved or whole, about 2-3 cm diameter each, roughly 12 pieces in a cluster across the center-right of the plate, juicy and firm, holding shape | 150
ITEM 3 | Shredded kimchi, bright red-orange with pale white-green strands, moist and slightly glossy with visible chili flakes, forming a mound about 6 cm by 4 cm on the upper right of the plate, sitting beside the fish and vegetables | 50
ITEM 4 | Cooked white fish fillet, flaky light cream interior with golden-brown seared edges, moist, partly covered by tomatoes and green beans, the visible portion spanning about 8 cm by 5 cm and about 1.5 cm thick, with a light sheen | 120
ITEM 5 | Grilled zucchini or squash slices, dark green skin with char marks and lighter pale flesh showing at the cut edge, soft and slightly wilted, about 6 cm long pieces, on the right edge of the plate next to the kimchi | 40
ITEM 6 | Dark greenish-brown cooked vegetable (possibly sautéed leafy greens or mushroom), glossy and soft with a darker sheen and some wilted texture, about 5 cm by 3 cm, sitting on the right of the fish near the zucchini | 35
